task.title: Deduplicate automatic chat-memory recall
task.source: Direct maintainer report reproduced against a long-running conversation on the Raspberry Pi

coreClaim: All conversations collapse duplicate automatic transcript chunks before recall limits and persist only one automatic memory per source-message chunk.
rootCause: Focused automatic capture rebuilt uncovered historical transcript chunks and then appended preserved copies of those same chunks without a final identity check.

inScope: Read-time duplicate protection for existing chat memories
Write-time duplicate protection for chat-memory mutations
Current array and legacy string-serialized memory storage

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Duplicate automatic transcript chunks cannot consume multiple recall slots and are removed from persisted chat memory on the next memory write or focused capture.
claimBoundary.riskType: storage integrity and prompt recall diversity
entrypoints: Chat memory create, update, status, import, and cleanup writes
currentPathsOrFormats: Chat memories stored as JSON arrays
legacyPathsOrFormats: Chat memories stored as a serialized JSON array string
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not increase the conversation history limit.
This change does not pin or change generation models.
This change does not merge user-edited, command, or imported memories merely because they cite the same messages.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: One automatic transcript chunk could be stored repeatedly and occupy several of the limited recall results.
contractLaneGate.consumer: chat-memory recall, export, and subsequent memory mutations
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: One automatic source-message chunk represents one recall candidate while user-owned memory records retain their distinct identity.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: A shared storage-owner helper rejects repeated memory ids and repeated refresh-owned message-id chunk keys on reads, normal writes, and focused refresh results.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The chat-memory storage owner parses legacy/current values, owns mutation persistence, and builds automatic capture rows.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not special-case Harlequin, filter duplicates only in prompt assembly, or delete user-edited memories by content.
regressionProof: A focused refresh after a full transcript refresh keeps one uncovered historical chunk instead of appending a duplicate.
A legacy string-serialized chat collapses duplicate automatic chunks before applying the recall limit.
The negative row preserves a user-edited memory that cites the same source messages.

positiveRows.claim: Existing corrupted chats recall distinct automatic chunks before the result limit.
positiveRows.evidence: The listing regression stores two automatic rows with one message-id chunk and asserts only the first consumes a recall slot.

positiveRows.claim: Future focused captures persist one row for each automatic message-id chunk.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused-refresh regression starts with two transcript chunks, captures the final exchange, and asserts two unique stored chunks rather than three rows.

positiveRows.claim: Normal chat-memory writes also heal duplicates.
positiveRows.evidence: All writes through set_chat_memory_values use the same deduplication helper; the complete 51-test chat-memory module passes.

contradictionRows.claim: A user-edited memory must not be merged with an automatic chunk that cites the same messages.
contradictionRows.evidence: The listing regression retains the userEdited row alongside the surviving automatic row.

contradictionRows.claim: A recall limit must not be applied before duplicate removal.
contradictionRows.evidence: The listing regression requests three rows and receives the older distinct memory instead of the stale duplicate.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Legacy string-serialized chat memories receive the same read protection.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The listing regression seeds the duplicated rows as a serialized JSON array string.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing chat-memory operations retain their behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: All 51 owner-module tests and the full pnpm check pass.

untestedRows: The exact merged container image is verified on the Raspberry Pi after merge.
No live conversation is mutated solely for deployment verification.

ownedFacts.description: The inspected long conversation contained many repeated Automatic transcript chunk capture rows sharing the same memory ids.
ownedFacts.evidence: Read-only inspection of the Raspberry Pi chat collection before implementation.

ownedFacts.description: The recall scorer could fill all eight result slots with copies of one duplicated memory.
ownedFacts.evidence: The current recall selection algorithm was run read-only against the duplicated stored rows.

userActionCopy.description: No migration or manual cleanup is required. Optional rollback protection is a stopped-app copy of the current chat collection and companion pending journal.
userActionCopy.action: Stop De-Koi, copy the listed files, verify the copies exist, then start the update. Do not delete or move the source files.

negativeRowsTested: User-edited memory with the same message ids remains distinct
Recall limit is applied after deduplication
Focused refresh persists unique chunk keys

notes: No user chat content is included in this ledger.
Existing stored duplicates become harmless on read and are persisted away on the next chat-memory write.
